grade_rationale: 5 P1 findings (QO: 2, DEP: 3) exceeds C threshold of max_p1: 2
skip_reason: Backend (port 3001) and Frontend (port 5173) services offline — static mode only

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary Code Execution
escalations.exploit_scenario: Vitest UI server bound to 0.0.0.0 allows any network peer to read and execute arbitrary files via the dev server API — no authentication required.

escalations.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution via Proto Parsing
escalations.exploit_scenario: If an attacker can supply a malicious .proto file to the orchestrator (e.g., via a compromised dependency or an upload path), protobufjs unsafe.parse() executes embedded JavaScript — full RCE on the orchestrator host.
escalations.fix: npm install protobufjs@>=8.0.0 in platform/orchestrator (breaking — requires code changes; solo session only per CLAUDE.md)

p1_backlog.title: Traceability enforcer blind to portal/ and platform/ — mandatory gate is a false pass
p1_backlog.exploit_scenario: The CLAUDE.md-mandated gate runs and returns PASS while silently skipping 88% of the codebase (portal/ with 1,073 Verifies: comments; platform/ with FR-TMP-* coverage). Any requirement gap in portal/ or platform/ is permanently invisible to CI.
p1_backlog.recommendation: Add 'portal' and 'platform/orchestrator' to source_dirs in the enforcer, or read from inspector.config.yml.

p1_backlog.title: Nondeterministic plan selection — enforcer checks different plans across CI environments
p1_backlog.exploit_scenario: All 8 Plans/*/requirements.md files have identical mtime. The enforcer's max(req_files, key=os.path.getmtime) is position-dependent on equal keys — different Linux/macOS/CI filesystem orderings select different plans. Compliance claims are environment-dependent.
p1_backlog.recommendation: Require --plan or --file argument explicitly in CI. Or scan all plans in one pass.

p1_backlog.title: @grpc/grpc-js Server Crash on Malformed gRPC Requests
p1_backlog.exploit_scenario: A single malformed gRPC request or compressed message crashes the gRPC server process in platform/orchestrator. Any peer that can reach the gRPC port (default 50051) can take down the orchestrator — halting all pipeline agents.
p1_backlog.recommendation: npm install @grpc/grpc-js@>=1.14.4 in platform/orchestrator (solo session only per CLAUDE.md)
p1_backlog.fix_team: TheFixer (escalate to solo session for platform/)
p1_backlog.cross_ref: DEP-002 (same file — coordinate into single orchestrator patch)

p2_backlog.title: blocked_by field missing from UpdateBugInput / UpdateFeatureRequestInput; as any cast active
p2_backlog.recommendation: Add blocked_by?: string[]; to both interfaces. Remove as any casts.

p2_backlog.title: FR-dependency-seed unimplemented — portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts does not exist
p2_backlog.recommendation: Create seed.ts with check-before-insert logic; wire into index.ts startup.

p2_backlog.title: Missing required test files: DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx
p2_backlog.recommendation: Create both test files with // Verifies: FR-dependency-section and FR-dependency-blocked-badge comments.

p2_backlog.title: FR-TMP-006, FR-TMP-008, FR-TMP-010 have no Verifies: comments; platform/ outside enforcer scope
p2_backlog.recommendation: Add traceability comments. NOTE: platform/ requires solo session per CLAUDE.md.

p2_backlog.title: brace-expansion DoS via Memory Exhaustion
p2_backlog.recommendation: Upgrade build dependencies to pull in fixed brace-expansion transitively.
